description: This file defines a mock class 'OpenCDMSystemMock' for unit testing purposes, inheriting from 'OpenCDMSystem'. It uses Google Test's mocking framework to mock various methods related to DRM system operations, such as creating sessions, retrieving hashes, and deleting stores.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystemMock
classes.description: Mock class for OpenCDMSystem used in unit testing, providing mocked implementations of DRM system methods.

methods.name: keySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier as a string.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata information as a string.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on LDL sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.
